content: I recommend to use the pliers to remove them by putting them around both end where no latch is and one of the allen keys to press the latch.
Don't miss the black one at the top. It's a sideways connector that is not white. Tweezers can also work well to get the lock depressed or help pull out the cable while you use a thumb on the lock.

I found it easier to remove these cables with the idler locked in the up position and then used a tiny flat head screw driver to help assist unplugging the cables.  I'd make sure the tabs were depressed and then use the flat head to ease them out.
